summary:
Comprehensive implementation summary covering:
1. Complete Light Theme contrast fixes (resolved washed out text in promise cards, imgband, workflow steps, and chip overlaps).
2. Clean canonical URLs without folder or file extensions (/work, /about, /packages, /contact, /admin, /vitalcare, /mitti, /apex, /delta, etc.).
3. Ad Video Studio complete visual overhaul with dual aspect ratios (16:9 Landscape Desktop & 9:16 Portrait Mobile for Reels/Shorts), high-resolution project photography in Safari browser and titanium smartphone mockups, and subtle floating animations.
4. Refined Admin Portal with sticky top section navigation jump pills, quick live site links, and card IDs.
